lines.en: label day114:
scene residential
: So hot...
lines.zh: : 好热……

lines.en: : Dying...
lines.zh: : 要死了……

lines.en: : Need...water...
Hey there.
lines.zh: 你好啊。

lines.en: If you couldn’t tell, it’s excruciatingly hot today.
lines.zh: 看不出来吧，今天热得要命。

lines.en: So much so that halfway through wandering around Kumon-mi looking for something to do, I’m already prepared to call it quits.
lines.zh: 热到我在 Kumon-mi 里晃了半圈找事做，就已经准备打道回府了。

lines.en: Seriously, though, what gives?
lines.zh: 不过说真的，这是怎么回事啊？

lines.en: You’d think after resetting the world, Maya would have at least made it so the temperature isn’t threatening to melt my insides every day.
lines.zh: 你会以为 Maya 重置世界之后，至少能让气温别每天都热得要把我的内脏烤化吧。

lines.en: She mentioned being able to change things but...maybe something like the weather is out of her control?
lines.zh: 她说过她能改变一些东西，不过……也许天气这种事不在她的掌控范围内？

lines.en: Who even knows? Maybe she just likes the heat.
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？也许她就喜欢热。

lines.en: I come to a stop in front of a corner-store in the residential area next to the one Ami and I live in.
lines.zh: 我在 Ami 和我住的那片住宅区旁边的一家便利店前停下脚步。

lines.en: I don’t typically come over to this part of town, likely due to the fact that there isn’t really anything here- but I figured I might as well try something different today.
lines.zh: 我不太来镇上这一带，大概是因为这儿真的什么都没有——不过我想今天不妨试试换个花样。

lines.en: Plus, this also seems like a great chance to run into a side character.
lines.zh: 再说，这看起来也是个撞见某个配角的好机会。

lines.en: I wonder which one it will be this time?
lines.zh: 不知道这次会是谁呢？

lines.en: scene black
scene pizzakaori1
Oh, look. It’s Kaori.
lines.zh: 哦，瞧。是 Kaori。

lines.en: And she’s scowling at a pizza.
lines.zh: 而她正对着一块披萨皱眉头。

lines.en: That seems about right.
lines.zh: 看起来挺符合她的风格。

lines.en: : Tch-!
: This hot, circular cheese-and-tomato wheel is causing me anguish.
lines.zh: : 这个又热又圆的奶酪番茄轮子正在让我痛苦。

lines.en: : I have only eaten one out of eight triangles and I am already in pain.
lines.zh: : 八块三角形我只吃了一块，就已经难受了。

lines.en: : Am I...allergic to shapes? Is that what is happening?
lines.zh: : 我……该不会是对形状过敏吧？是这个情况吗？

lines.en: : Hey, Kaori. Having some trouble there?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Kaori。遇到点麻烦？

lines.en: scene pizzakaori2
: Hamburger Man?! What are you doing here?!
lines.zh: : 汉堡人？！你怎么会在这儿？！

lines.en: : And why are you without a [young_girl]?!
lines.zh: : 而且你身边怎么没有[young_girl]？！

lines.en: : I’m not...always with a [young_girl], Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我又不……总是和[young_girl]在一起，Kaori。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori3
: You’re not?
lines.zh: : 不是吗？

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: : 不是。

lines.en: : But you are almost always with a different small human.
lines.zh: : 可你身边几乎总是跟着一个不同的小小人类。

lines.en: : I was beginning to think you were part of a...umm...what’s the word-
lines.zh: : 我都开始觉得你是某个……嗯……那个词怎么说来着——

lines.en: : Human trafficking ring?
lines.zh: : 人口贩卖集团？

lines.en: : Human trafficking? Is that really the line of work you think I’m in?
lines.zh: : 人口贩卖？你真觉得我是干这行的？

lines.en: : Yes. None of the girls who have appeared beside you were ever seen again.
lines.zh: : 对。出现在你身边的那些女孩，没有一个再被人见过。

lines.en: : How much money does a human female go for, Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 一个人类女性值多少钱，汉堡人？

lines.en: : I’m a teacher, Kaori. That explains why I’m always with [younger_girls].
lines.zh: : 我是老师，Kaori。这就解释了为什么我总是和[younger_girls]在一起。

lines.en: Well, actually...it kind of doesn’t. But I doubt someone like her would understand that.
lines.zh: 嗯，其实……也算不上解释。不过我怀疑她这种人理解不了。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori4
: I smell deceit.
lines.zh: : 我闻到了欺骗的味道。

lines.en: : Deception doesn’t have a scent, Kaori. It’s probably just the pizza.
lines.zh: : 欺骗是没有气味的，Kaori。大概只是披萨的味道。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori5
: Yes! Pizza! {i}That{/i} is the proper name for the cheese wheel! Thank you, Hamburger Man!
lines.zh: : 对！披萨！{i}这个{/i}奶酪轮子的正确叫法！谢谢你，汉堡人！

lines.en: : I am now slightly closer to believing you are an actual teacher!
lines.zh: : 我现在稍微更愿意相信你真的是个老师了！

lines.en: I take a seat at the table opposite Kaori and put my elbows down on it, resting my chin in my hands.
lines.zh: 我在 Kaori 对面的桌子旁坐下，把胳膊肘搁在桌上，双手托着下巴。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori6
: Why are you sitting with me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要跟我坐一起？

lines.en: : I did not give you permission to sit here.
lines.zh: : 我没允许你坐这儿。

lines.en: : If you have come for the human-pizza, I am not willing to share.
lines.zh: : 如果你是为了人肉披萨来的，我可不愿意分享。

lines.en: : Okay well, first off, please don’t call it a human pizza. That makes it sound like something completely different.
lines.zh: : 好好好，首先，请别管它叫人肉披萨。这听起来完全像别的东西了。

lines.en: : Heard.
lines.zh: : 收到了。

lines.en: : Secondly, I’m not going to take anything from you unless you offer it.
lines.zh: : 其次，除非你主动给我，否则我不会从你这儿拿走任何东西。

lines.en: : You aren’t?
lines.zh: : 你不会？

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori7
A look of distrust spreads across Kaori’s face as she attempts to decipher human conversation and the connotations that come along with it.
lines.zh: Kaori 脸上浮现出一种不信任的神情，她试图解读人类的对话以及随之而来的言外之意。

lines.en: : I have a hard time following your reasoning, Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 我很难跟上你的思路，汉堡人。

lines.en: : You always seem to want food whenever I see you, and this time, you suddenly do not.
lines.zh: : 每次见到你，你似乎都想要吃的，而这一次，你突然又不要了。

lines.en: : Of course I always want food when I see you. You work in like nine different restaurants.
lines.zh: : 我当然每次见你都想要吃的啊。你在差不多九家不同的餐厅打工。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori8
: Is that not normal?
lines.zh: : 这不正常吗？

lines.en: : Of course it’s not normal. Most people only work in like one or two at a time.
lines.zh: : 当然不正常。大多数人一次只打一两份工。

lines.en: : But then...what do they do with all of their free time?
lines.zh: : 可是……那他们拿那么多空闲时间干什么？

lines.en: : Uhh...I don’t know. Don’t you have any hobbies?
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道。你就没有什么爱好吗？

lines.en: : I am unfamiliar with this word. “Hobby.”
lines.zh: : 我不认识这个词。「爱好」。

lines.en: : What does that mean? It sounds fake. Is that a fake word?
lines.zh: : 那是什么意思？听起来是假的。那是假词吗？

lines.en: : A hobby is something you like to do.
lines.zh: : 爱好就是你喜欢做的事。

lines.en: if cafe25 == True:
: You know, kind of like how you like taking pictures of yourself in your underwear and posting them online.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，就有点像你喜欢穿着内裤自拍，然后发到网上那样。

lines.en: I still haven’t seen those, now that I think about it...
lines.zh: 这么一想，我到现在都还没看过那些照片呢……

lines.en: scene pizzakaori9
: Why do you bring up the instant gram again?!
lines.zh: : 你为什么又提起那个即时 gram？！

lines.en: : I was unaware people could view those photos and have since deleted the account!
lines.zh: : 我不知道别人能看到那些照片，所以已经把账号删了！

lines.en: : My underwear is now safely stored in the private confines of my own logical telephone!
lines.zh: : 我的内裤现在安全地存放在我自己的逻辑电话的私密空间里！

lines.en: : Smartphone, Kaori. Smartphone.
lines.zh: : 智能手机，Kaori。智能手机。

lines.en: : Logical telephone!
lines.zh: : 逻辑电话！

lines.en: : Also, why do you need those pictures anyway?
lines.zh: : 还有，你到底为什么要留着那些照片？

lines.en: : That does not matter! Please progress the conversation to the next stage! My face feels hotter than normal!
lines.zh: : 那不重要！请把对话推进到下一个阶段！我的脸比平时更烫了！

lines.en: else:
: Do you have anything like that, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 你有没有类似的事呢，Kaori？

lines.en: scene pizzakaori7
: Something I like to do...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢做的事……

lines.en: : Or maybe something you’re just particularly interested in?
lines.zh: : 或者……有什么你特别感兴趣的东西？

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene pizzakaori9
: Furry things!
lines.zh: : 毛茸茸的东西！

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Furry things! Soft things! The ones that make cute noises like “woof” or “purr!”
lines.zh: : 毛茸茸的东西！软软的东西！会发出「汪」或者「呼噜」这种可爱声音的那些！

lines.en: : So, you like animals?
lines.zh: : 所以，你喜欢动物？

lines.en: : Yes! Are animals a hobby?
lines.zh: : 对！动物算是一种爱好吗？

lines.en: : Well, uhh, animals {i}themselves{/i} aren’t a hobby...but I guess stuff related to animals can be?
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃，动物{i}本身{/i}不算爱好……不过跟动物有关的事情大概算？

lines.en: : Then yes! This is what Kaori likes!
lines.zh: : 那就对了！这就是 Kaori 喜欢的东西！

lines.en: : Well, either way, I think you should try spending less time at work and more time doing fun stuff.
lines.zh: : 总之，我觉得你应该少花点时间在工作上，多花点时间做点有趣的事。

lines.en: : Life gets boring pretty quickly if all you do is work.
lines.zh: : 要是你只会工作，人生很快就会变得无聊。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori8
: Are you also a hard worker, Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 你也是个勤奋的人吗，汉堡人？

lines.en: Well...
I show up every day.
lines.zh: 我每天都出现。

lines.en: Does that count?
lines.zh: 这算吗？

lines.en: : I guess you could say that.
lines.zh: : 大概可以这么说吧。

lines.en: : I am impressed. I didn’t realize human trafficking required so much effort.
lines.zh: : 我很佩服。没想到人口贩卖需要这么费劲。

lines.en: : Again, I’m a teacher. Not a human trafficker.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，我是老师。不是人贩子。

lines.en: : Apologies. You are the first “teacher” I have come into contact with in many years. My knowledge of them is wearing out.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你是我这么多年来接触到的第一个「老师」。我对他们的了解正在磨损。

lines.en: : Many years? How old are you, Kaori?
lines.zh: : 很多年？你多大了，Kaori？

lines.en: : I am roughly 154 in dog-years.
lines.zh: : 按狗年算，我大概 154 岁。

lines.en: : Human years, please.
lines.zh: : 请说人类年。

lines.en: : Apologies. I am 22 in human-years.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。按人类年算，我 22 岁。

lines.en: : And you’re not in college or anything?
lines.zh: : 那你没上大学之类的吗？

lines.en: : What is a “college?”
lines.zh: : 「大学」是什么？

lines.en: : It’s like high school but for adults.
lines.zh: : 就像高中，不过是给成年人上的。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : What is a “high school?”
lines.zh: : 「高中」是什么？

lines.en: : It’s-
lines.zh: : 那是——

lines.en: : Wait, you didn’t go to high school?
lines.zh: : 等等，你没上过高中？

lines.en: : Would that be something I remembered if I did?
lines.zh: : 如果我上过，我会记得吗？

lines.en: : Uhh, yeah. Kind of.
lines.zh: : 呃，会。大概会。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Then no.
lines.zh: : 那就是没有。

lines.en: : No high school.
lines.zh: : 没上过高中。

lines.en: : Then...what the hell were you doing during your teenage years?
lines.zh: : 那……你青春期那几年到底在干什么？

lines.en: : I think I went to the “movies” once.
lines.zh: : 我想我去过一次「电影院」。

lines.en: I swear, this girl gets even more confusing every time I talk to her.
lines.zh: 我发誓，每次跟这个女孩说话，她都变得更让人摸不着头脑。

lines.en: : So, let me get this straight-
lines.zh: : 那么，让我理清楚——

lines.en: : You didn’t go to high school...
lines.zh: : 你没上过高中……

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : You didn’t go to college...
lines.zh: : 你没上过大学……

lines.en: : Correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : But you did go to the movies once.
lines.zh: : 但你确实去过一次电影院。

lines.en: : I think so, yes.
lines.zh: : 我想是的，对。

lines.en: : How are you landing all of these jobs?
lines.zh: : 那你是怎么找到这些工作的？

lines.en: scene pizzakaori10
: Restaurants do not require formal education and typically accept any help they can get.
lines.zh: : 餐厅不要求正规学历，通常只要有人肯帮忙就收。

lines.en: : So I have done nothing but that for as long as I can remember.
lines.zh: : 所以从我有记忆以来，我就一直在干这个。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll concede that you’re a pretty good waitress but-
lines.zh: : 好吧，我承认你是个相当不错的服务员，不过——

lines.en: scene pizzakaori4
: I am the {i}best{/i} waitress.
lines.zh: : 我是{i}最好{/i}的服务员。

lines.en: : Right, you are the {i}best{/i} waitress, but...I just can’t imagine life being all that exciting if you don’t do anything other than that.
lines.zh: : 对，你是{i}最好{/i}的服务员，可是……我只是没法想象，除了这个什么都不做，人生会有什么意思。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori10
: Do you have a suggestion for things to do instead? You seem to know a lot about human life.
lines.zh: : 那你有什么建议，告诉我该做点什么吗？你似乎很懂人类的生活。

lines.en: : Yeah, most humans do.
lines.zh: : 是啊，大多数人类都懂。

lines.en: : How about this, though-
lines.zh: : 不过这样吧——

lines.en: : What if I took you around and kind of just, showed you stuff every once in a while?
lines.zh: : 要不我偶尔带你到处走走，就……给你看看各种东西？

lines.en: : You would be my human-life coach?
lines.zh: : 你要当我的「人类生活教练」？

lines.en: : I mean, it would probably be easier to call me your friend, but sure.
lines.zh: : 我是说，叫我朋友可能更省事，不过也行。

lines.en: : How much does this service cost, Hamburger Man?
lines.zh: : 这项服务多少钱，汉堡人？

lines.en: : It’s...free?
lines.zh: : 这个……免费？

lines.en: scene pizzakaori2
: You will teach me the proper way to live for no money at all?! Human traff- {i}teachers{/i} must make a lot of money!
lines.zh: : 你愿意一分钱不收就教我正确的生活方式？！人贩——{i}老师{/i}一定赚很多钱吧！

lines.en: We really don’t, unfortunately...
lines.zh: 很遗憾，我们真的没有……

lines.en: : Well, there is one thing you can give me...
lines.zh: : 嗯，倒是有一样东西你可以给我……

lines.en: scene pizzakaori11
: Ah-
Kaori pauses for a moment and...starts to blush?
lines.zh: Kaori 停顿了一下，然后……开始脸红？

lines.en: scene pizzakaori12
: I...suppose {i}that{/i} sort of thing...might be possible...
lines.zh: : 我……想{i}那种事{/i}……也不是不行……

lines.en: : Kaori, what exactly do you think I’m going to ask you to do?
lines.zh: : Kaori，你到底以为我要让你做什么？

lines.en: scene pizzakaori11
: You know exactly what you’re going to ask for, Hamburger Man.
lines.zh: : 你很清楚你要提什么要求，汉堡人。

lines.en: : I have not done it before but-
lines.zh: : 我以前没做过，不过——

lines.en: : I was just going to ask for your phone number...
lines.zh: : 我只是想要你的电话号码……

lines.en: scene pizzakaori13
: My face feels very hot all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我的脸突然好烫。

lines.en: : I will give you my phone number if you can make it stop.
lines.zh: : 如果你能让它停下来，我就把电话号码给你。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. Whatever.
lines.zh: : 行，好。随便吧。

lines.en: Kaori writes her phone number down on a slip of receipt paper and hands it to me.
lines.zh: Kaori 把她的电话号码写在一张收据纸条上，递给了我。

lines.en: : I still feel the heat.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得热。

lines.en: : It’ll go away soon.
lines.zh: : 很快就会好的。

lines.en: : How soon?
lines.zh: : 多快？

lines.en: : Soon.
lines.zh: : 很快。

lines.en: : How soon?
lines.zh: : 多快？

lines.en: : Kaori, chill.
lines.zh: : Kaori，冷静点。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori14
: Oh, it’s gone.
lines.zh: : 哦，没了。

lines.en: scene pizzakaori15
: You can...have some of the cheese circle if you’d like.
lines.zh: : 你可以……吃一点那个奶酪圆圈，如果你想要的话。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。

lines.en: scene black
Kaori and I sit at the table eating pizza for another few minutes before a small cat runs by.
lines.zh: 我和 Kaori 又在桌边吃了几分钟披萨，直到一只小猫跑了过去。

lines.en: She immediately takes off down the alleyway to catch it.
lines.zh: 她立刻冲进小巷去追它。

lines.en: Sensing that she won’t be coming back any time soon, I wind up asking for a box to take the rest of the pizza home.
lines.zh: 感觉她一时半会儿不会回来了，我便要了个盒子，把剩下的披萨带回家。

lines.en: I hope we have room in the fridge for this...
lines.zh: 希望冰箱里还放得下……

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You now have Kaori’s phone number.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你现在有 Kaori 的电话号码了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Use it to call her during your spare time to raise your affection with her!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在空闲时间用它给她打电话，可以提升你与她的好感度！{/i}

lines.en: $ kaorinumber = True
$ day114 = True
jump endofweekday
